queries: how do I log my brushing
response:
To log your brushing session in ToothMate:

1. **Dashboard**: Navigate to the **Home / Dashboard** screen.
2. **Start Session**: Click the large **'Start 2-Min Brushing'** timer button.
3. **Guided Brushing**: Follow the 4-quadrant visual guide as the timer runs for 2 minutes.
4. **Completion**: Once finished, your session is automatically saved to your streak stats!

To view your brushing habit stats and streak progress:

1. Go to the **Dashboard** or **Analytics** tab.
2. View your **Current Streak (Days)**, **Total Sessions Logged**, and **Morning vs Evening Consistency**.
3. Check your weekly compliance calendar to ensure 100% oral hygiene consistency!

ToothMate sends push notifications for your morning and evening brushing sessions:

1. Open your **Profile / Settings** screen.
2. Tap **'Brushing Reminders'**.
3. Set your preferred **Morning Alarm Time** (e.g., 08:00 AM) and **Night Alarm Time** (e.g., 10:00 PM).
4. Save settings to receive timely daily reminders!

To update your personal profile in ToothMate:

1. Tap the **Profile / Avatar** icon in the navigation bar.
2. Tap **'Edit Profile'** to update your Name, Age Group, or Gender.
3. Click **'Save Changes'** to update your personalized oral health recommendations.

You can access your dental doctor prescriptions anytime:

1. Tap the **Prescriptions** icon from the bottom navigation or quick menu.
2. View your active medication schedules, dosage instructions, and doctor notes.
3. Tap any prescription item to set medication reminder alarms!

ToothMate's AI Assessment evaluates your oral health risk in 10 seconds:

1. Go to the **Assessment** tab.
2. Answer a few simple questions about sensitivity, bleeding, and habits.
3. Receive your personalized **Oral Health Risk Score** and recommended dental care routine!

Clinical Guide to Toothpaste Ingredients:

• **Bleeding Gums / Gingivitis**: Use **Stannous Fluoride (SnF2)** toothpaste (e.g., Parodontax, Crest Pro-Health) which kills plaque bacteria along the gumline.
• **Sensitive Teeth**: Use **Potassium Nitrate** toothpaste (e.g., Sensodyne) which calms nerve signals inside dentin tubules.
• **Cavity Prevention**: Look for 1450 ppm **Fluoride** or **Nano-Hydroxyapatite (nHAp)** to remineralize enamel.
• **Whitening**: Choose low-abrasivity silica formulas to avoid wearing down tooth enamel.

The **Modified Bass Technique** is the gold standard method recommended by periodontists worldwide:

1. **Angle**: Place toothbrush bristles at a **45-degree angle** pointing directly toward your gumline sulcus.
2. **Vibrate**: Apply light pressure and execute short, gentle vibratory circular motions for 10 seconds per 2-3 teeth.
3. **Sweep**: Firmly roll/sweep the brush head away from the gums toward the chewing surface to sweep out dislodged plaque.
4. **Duration & Frequency**: Spend 2 full minutes twice daily.

Electric vs Manual Toothbrush Clinical Comparison:

• **Electric Toothbrushes**: Deliver 30,000 to 40,000 micro-vibrations per minute, feature built-in 2-minute timers, and pressure sensors that prevent enamel erosion. Highly recommended for braces, implants, or gum recession.
• **Manual Toothbrushes**: Very effective if used with soft bristles and the Modified Bass technique for 2 full minutes. Replace your brush head every 3 months!

Clinical Assessment for Bleeding Gums (Gingivitis):

• **Cause**: Bacterial plaque buildup along the gumline causing localized inflammation.
• **Action**: **DO NOT stop brushing or flossing!** Continue brushing gently with soft bristles angled at 45 degrees.
• **Toothpaste & Rinse**: Use Stannous Fluoride toothpaste and an alcohol-free CPC antibacterial mouthwash.
• **Flossing**: Floss daily using a C-shape curve around each tooth surface to clean under the gumline.
• **Professional Care**: Schedule a professional dental scaling (cleaning) if bleeding persists over 7 days.

Proper Flossing Routine:

1. **Length**: Use 18 inches of string floss, wrapping ends around your middle fingers.
2. **C-Shape**: Gently glide floss between teeth and hug the side of one tooth in a 'C' shape.
3. **Motion**: Slide up and down along the tooth surface beneath the gumline.
4. **Water Flossers**: Excellent alternative for braces or bridges to flush out interdental debris!

Clinical Assessment for Tooth Sensitivity:

• **Cause**: Exposed dentin tubules due to enamel erosion, aggressive scrubbing, or gum recession.
• **Immediate Relief**: Use **Potassium Nitrate (Sensodyne)** toothpaste twice daily. Do not rinse with water immediately after brushing so active minerals remain on teeth.
• **Brushing Habit**: Switch to an ultra-soft toothbrush and avoid hard horizontal scrubbing.
• **Clinical Care**: Visit your dentist for professional fluoride varnish or bonding if pain persists.

Emergency First Aid for Severe Toothache:

1. **Rinse**: Swish warm salt water (1/2 tsp salt in warm water) to clean bacteria and soothe inflammation.
2. **Floss**: Gently floss around the painful tooth to remove trapped food particles.
3. **Pain Relief**: Take over-the-counter pain relievers (Ibuprofen or Acetaminophen) as directed. **Never place aspirin directly against your gums!**
4. **Cold Compress**: Apply an ice pack outside your cheek for 15 minutes.
5. **Dental Visit**: Schedule an immediate dental evaluation if pain is accompanied by facial swelling or fever.

Senior Clinical Explanation of Root Canal Treatment (RCT):

1. **Purpose**: Saves a severely decayed or infected tooth by removing inflamed nerve tissue inside root canals.
2. **Pain Management**: Performed under local anesthesia — the procedure is **completely painless**!
3. **Steps**: The dentist cleans, disinfects, and seals the canals with Gutta-Percha, then places a protective dental crown.
4. **Recovery**: Mild post-procedure tenderness resolves in 2-3 days with standard OTC pain relievers.

Orthodontic & Appliance Care Guide:

• **Braces Hygiene**: Brush using **Charters Technique** (bristles angled toward brackets). Use interdental proxy brushes under archwires.
• **Poking Wires**: Place orthodontic relief wax over sharp wire tips to protect cheek tissue.
• **Aligners / Retainers**: Clean aligners with lukewarm water and a soft toothbrush daily. **Never use hot water** as it warps plastic!

Special Population Oral Care Guidelines:

• **Pediatric Care**: Use a rice-sized smear of fluoride toothpaste for infants under 3, and a pea-sized amount for children 3-6. Practice Fones circular brushing.
• **Senior Care**: Dentures must be removed overnight and brushed with denture cleanser (not regular toothpaste). Drink water frequently to manage dry mouth (xerostomia).

Teeth Whitening Safety Guidelines:

1. **Hydrogen Peroxide**: In-office or custom dental tray bleaching is safest for enamel.
2. **Avoid Scrubbing**: Do not use harsh charcoal abrasives which scrape away healthy enamel.
3. **Sensitivity Care**: Use Potassium Nitrate desensitizing toothpaste before and after whitening treatments.
